en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large spa‑hotel style building in a landscaped garden, with wooded hills in the background and another villa on the hillside. Red printed title text at the top reads "Bad Harzburg. Juliushall und Belveder." and a vertical publisher credit appears at the left edge. On the façade of the main building, the name of the hotel company is visible.
